gettingHere.title: Finding us
gettingHere.text: We are four kilometres inland from Stone Town on Kisakasaka Road, past the Kizimbani junction. The visitor gate is the second entrance, marked by a blue flag pole and a stone sign.
landmarks: 12 minutes from Stone Town by car
15 minutes from Abeid Amani Karume International Airport
Dala-dala routes 04 and 07 stop at Kisakasaka stage, then a five-minute walk
gettingHere.parking: Twenty visitor spaces inside the gate on weekdays before 08:00 and after 13:30; during the school day use the Open Day bay beside the library.

careers.title: We Are Hiring — Join Our Team
careers.text: Be part of a dedicated team shaping future leaders! We are recruiting passionate educators for our Cambridge and NECTA wings as well as key administrative and IT specialists ahead of the January 2027 intake.
requirements: Cover letter stating the position applied for
openings: Cambridge Wing Teachers — English, Art & Design, Mathematics/Science, Humanities, PE/Global Perspectives
General Wing Teachers — All Subjects (Passionate about Education, Team Player, Strong Communication)
Accountant — Bachelor's degree in Accounting/Finance; financial records, invoicing, reconciliations & budgeting
Receptionist — Diploma/Certificate in Office Management or Administration; front desk, calls & MS Office
Media & IT Officer — Degree/Diploma in Media, ICT or Computer Science; school media content, website & IT systems
